name: node-av
role: Node.js FFmpeg bindings for in-process audio/video decoding, filtering and encoding
notes: 2026-11-15: Assess because the digest identifies in-process FFmpeg from a Node render loop as a distinct route from CLI and WebCodecs neighbours. Revisit after checking native binaries, FFmpeg build flags, bundled codecs and determinism.
2026-11-15: Assessment uncertainty: bundled FFmpeg build flags, enabled codecs and their licence implications vary by published platform package; verify the selected binary before redistribution.
2026-11-24: Guide written from the node-av-decode-encode evidence (7.1.0, bundled FFmpeg 8.1.3, macOS arm64, Node 22); scope is H.264 decode and libx264 re-encode only.

evidence.result: 24 frames 320x240 yuv420p, 24 distinct frame hashes, pts increasing; libx264 re-encode via node-av; output ffprobe h264 320x240 yuv420p 24 frames 24/1 matches predeclared; round-trip decode matches; bundled FFmpeg 8.1.3; Node v22.19.0
evidence.scope: In Node, node-av 7.1.0 decodes a 24-frame 320x240 H.264 MP4 frame by frame and re-encodes it with libx264, ffprobe fields match; macOS arm64. Not quality, audio or hardware.

summary: Node.js bindings exposing low and high level FFmpeg APIs for decode, filter and encode workflows, with platform-specific native packages and bundled FFmpeg binaries. This provides in-process media operations and hardware acceleration options; FFmpeg build and codec availability are version and platform specific.
use_when: Call FFmpeg media APIs from a Node.js application without shelling out
Use its documented native bindings and platform packages in Node/Electron workflows
avoid_when: Use ffmpeg-ffprobe for portable CLI based encoding and probing
Use WebCodecs for browser-native media operations
license: MIT (project code; bundled FFmpeg binary and codec licensing depend on build contents)

assessment.rationale: Official release page shows v7.0.4-beta.1 on 2026-11-13 and platform-specific native and FFmpeg packages. The prebuilt FFmpeg build/codec terms and exact determinism remain platform-specific.
